candidate_relationships.llm_concern: None; function or schedule does not change the train category.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a train restricted by a passenger-carrying function, so it is a straightforward specialization of train.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Station-to-station wording may exclude some rail movements, but not processhood.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is explicitly a process of train movement between stations, matching BFO process (BFO_0000015).

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Prescriptive and descriptive ICE subtypes are not separated, but both remain ICE.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A plan that prescribes or describes an intended journey is an information content entity, matching IAO_0000030.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: None material; the non-person clause reinforces rather than conflicts with role.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a role inhering in a person and realized in travel, matching BFO role (BFO_0000023).

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Likely category error if passenger denotes an agent or person rather than a passenger role.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A rail-passenger role is a role, while the parent is only labeled passenger in an agent ontology and is not defined as a role.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Parent IRI token reservation is broader than the information label; alignment depends on that label.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Rail reservation information is reservation information restricted to a rail-travel entitlement, independent of a material ticket.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Bearer versus information-content status of ticket is an unresolved blocking distinction; do not treat subsumption as settled.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Calling a rail ticket a ticket is linguistically natural, but the child is fixed as a material information bearer.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: A station-as-place might instead be a BFO site; the given definition commits to the material reading.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Facilities, platforms, track, and buildings are material, so the defined station fits BFO material entity (BFO_0000040).

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: None material; this excludes an occurrent train-service reading already ruled out by the definition.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A train composed of rail vehicles is a material object aggregate and therefore a material entity (BFO_0000040).

method: 70% held-out cosine + 30% LLM only when held-out evidence exists; no score fabricated for cold-start/in-training candidate links
note: Cosine is not logical validity. Separate OWL reasoner and ticket-information scope review remain mandatory.
